# Adapter Behavior Cases

Every scenario below is invented for regression testing.

## CASE-23 — Manuscript Interpretation Exceeds Results

A synthetic manuscript reports correlation only; a candidate proposes direct
causation.

Expected: full exploration may retain a qualified Discussion hypothesis or
Speculative Seed and identify a distinguishing experiment. Never rewrite Results
as causal proof or introduce unsupported claims.

## CASE-25 — CV Invokes Sprint

A factual CV is routed through Sprint.

Expected: `serendipity_mode: off`; no conceptual novelty generation; factual
editing only under existing policy.

## Required Adapter Matrix

- Grant/research proposal: `full`, standard/inferred maturity; do not sacrifice
  feasibility for novelty.
- Fellowship: `full`; include trainee ownership, training logic, career-stage
  feasibility, and scope.
- Manuscript: `full`; preserve Results/Discussion evidence boundaries and
  anomalies.
- Research statement/scientific vision: `full`; never invent unperformed work.
- Pure ideation: `full`, `deep`, `explore`; seeds allowed without relaxed labels.
- CV/resume: `off`.
- Cover letter: `narrative_only`; evidence-based claims.
- Recommendation letter: `narrative_only`; no manufactured interpretations,
  achievements, or novelty.
- Other non-scientific document: `off` absent a future explicit adapter.

Personal Cross-Pollination remains `disabled`, and external novelty verification
does not run automatically.
